ENTRY.NAME: Iron Fusion Vault (Female)
ENTRY.DESCRIPTION: Hidden in a top secret location, this Vault is filled with a collection of new suits from Iron Fusion, each with their own individual mechanics. The Iron Fusion Vault holds the secrets to metering out swift justice in PlayStation®Home. Upon entering the Iron Fusion Vault, the owner will be awarded Mechjet – Glory plus four special suits: Panthabot – Teigra, Mechjet – Ferruma, Mechjet – Ragnara and Mechsuit-Pilot – Necra.
